# Welcome to my website!

My name is Maleek Cusack and I am an MPH student at CWRU as well as an intern at the Cleveland Department of Public Health. The areas of interest are epidemiology; disease surveillance; and governmental intervention programming, implementation, and evaluation.

I am currently developing my skills in data management, analysis, and visualization using tools such as R, Canva, SAS, Python, and ARCGis Pro. I plan to be a friendly and accessible face in the oftentimes opaque world of governmental public health.

I completed my undergraduate at Oberlin college with a BA in Biology and previously worked in pharmaceutical and clinical labs at Xellia pharmaceuticals and Cleveland Clinic's Manual Hematology lab.

My projected graduation semester is Fall 2026.
